card.name: Words before "supportive" in overdose care
card.fires_on: The word "and" after "symptomatic", or "general" or "managed", just before "supportive" measures or therapy. It appears in overdosage sections that say there is no specific antidote.

modes.label: "and" after symptomatic
modes.description: The linking word "and" between "symptomatic" and "supportive" in overdose treatment advice.
modes.example: Treatment should be symptomatic<< and>> supportive.

modes.label: "general" before supportive
modes.description: The word "general" after "consists of", right before "supportive measures".
modes.example: Treatment of overdose with BIKTARVY consists of<< general>> supportive measures including monitoring of vital signs as

modes.label: "managed" before supportive therapy
modes.description: A verb like "managed" right before "with appropriate supportive therapy".
modes.example: Patients should be<< managed>> with appropriate supportive therapy.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "supportive" (or "support", "sup-") as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "supportive" in overdose advice such as "symptomatic and supportive care".
